about.intro_lead: I'm Emily Bezerra, 26, a Full Stack Developer and Software Engineering student at Universidade Cesumar. I grew up on the coast of São Paulo and learned early on that opportunities rarely come ready-made — they are built with effort, discipline, and persistence.
about.intro_p1: My journey began long before technology. As a teenager, I completed technical courses in Chemistry and Environmental Science, then started my career at the Catholic University of Santos, where I worked for five years as a Laboratory Technician. It was in that environment — surrounded by research, innovation, and problem-solving — that I had my first real encounter with technology, and learned that every chance to learn is an opportunity not to waste.
about.intro_p2: Curiosity quickly turned into passion — and then into a life decision. In 2023 I started my career transition: I joined Cubos Academy to deepen my web development skills and began a Software Engineering degree, balancing intensive evening studies with my work routine. In September 2024 I got my first tech opportunity as an intern at Boneside and, a few months later, was promoted to Junior Developer.
about.intro_p3: Today I develop a multi-tenant SaaS ERP in Modular Monolith architecture, with .NET 10 on the backend and Angular 21 on the frontend — working daily with C#, Entity Framework Core, SQL Server, Azure, Docker, TypeScript, PrimeNG, and Tailwind CSS. I have a strong interest in modern interfaces that unite development, performance, and design. I use AI tools strategically to accelerate delivery and elevate technical quality. More than writing code, I believe in technology as a tool for transformation — and my journey proves that curiosity and the courage to start over can open entirely new paths.
